description: Test whether pathogenic in-frame DMD deletions spare the actin-binding and dystroglycan-binding modules, as the canonical mechanical-link model predicts
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, requests
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

D=pd.read_csv("clinvar_dmd_cnv_exonmapped.csv")
dele=D[D.obj_type.isin(["Deletion","copy number loss"])].copy()
dele["frame"]=np.where(dele.frame_mod3==0,"in-frame","out-of-frame")
print("exon-mapped pathogenic deletions:", len(dele))

# Dystrophin domain map (exon numbering, DMD canonical Dp427m; standard assignments)
DOMAINS=[("ABD1 (actin-binding, CH1-CH2)",2,8),
         ("Hinge 1",9,10),
         ("Rod repeats R1-R15",11,41),
         ("Rod R16-R17 (nNOS-binding)",42,45),
         ("Rod R18-R24 + Hinge3",46,62),
         ("Cysteine-rich (beta-dystroglycan binding)",63,70),
         ("C-terminal (syntrophin/dystrobrevin)",71,79)]
def dom_hits(r):
    out=[]
    for name,a,b in DOMAINS:
        if not (r.last_exon < a or r.first_exon > b): out.append(name)
    return out
dele["domains"]=dele.apply(dom_hits, axis=1)
for name,a,b in DOMAINS:
    dele[name]=dele.domains.map(lambda L: name in L)

# ---- Test A: do pathogenic IN-FRAME deletions avoid the DGC-binding modules? ----
inf=dele[dele.frame=="in-frame"]; oof=dele[dele.frame=="out-of-frame"]
rows=[]
for name,a,b in DOMAINS:
    ai=int(inf[name].sum()); ao=int(oof[name].sum())
    tab=[[ai,len(inf)-ai],[ao,len(oof)-ao]]
    orr,p=stats.fisher_exact(tab)
    rows.append(dict(domain=name, exons=f"{a}-{b}", inframe_n=ai, inframe_pct=100*ai/len(inf),
                     oof_n=ao, oof_pct=100*ao/len(oof), OR=orr, p=p))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\nDomain involvement of pathogenic deletions, in-frame vs out-of-frame (ClinVar, n=%d/%d):"%(len(inf),len(oof)))
print(T[["domain","exons","inframe_n","inframe_pct","oof_n","oof_pct","OR","p"]].to_string(index=False,
      float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.3g}"))
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
T["p_fdr"]=multipletests(T.p, method="fdr_bh")[1]
print("\nFDR-adjusted p:", dict(zip(T.domain, T.p_fdr.round(4))))
T.to_csv("clinvar_dmd_domain_frame_test.csv", index=False)

# ---- Test B: critical-domain involvement regardless of frame ----
crit = dele["Cysteine-rich (beta-dystroglycan binding)"] | dele["ABD1 (actin-binding, CH1-CH2)"]
print("\nDeletions touching a DGC-link module (ABD1 or cysteine-rich):",
      f"{crit.sum()}/{len(dele)} ({100*crit.mean():.1f}%)")
print("  of in-frame deletions:", f"{int(crit[dele.frame=='in-frame'].sum())}/{len(inf)} ({100*crit[dele.frame=='in-frame'].mean():.1f}%)")
print("  of out-of-frame deletions:", f"{int(crit[dele.frame=='out-of-frame'].sum())}/{len(oof)} ({100*crit[dele.frame=='out-of-frame'].mean():.1f}%)")

# ---- Test C: R16/17 (nNOS) involvement among in-frame (Becker-compatible) deletions ----
r1617=dele["Rod R16-R17 (nNOS-binding)"]
print("\nR16/17 (exons 42-45, nNOS-binding) removed in %d/%d (%.1f%%) in-frame pathogenic deletions"
      %(int(r1617[dele.frame=='in-frame'].sum()), len(inf), 100*r1617[dele.frame=='in-frame'].mean()))

# ---- Figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(14,5))
y=np.arange(len(T)); w=0.38
axes[0].barh(y-w/2, T.inframe_pct, w, label=f"in-frame (n={len(inf)})", color="#55A868")
axes[0].barh(y+w/2, T.oof_pct,  w, label=f"out-of-frame (n={len(oof)})", color="#C44E52")
axes[0].set_yticks(y); axes[0].set_yticklabels([f"{d}\n(ex {e})" for d,e in zip(T.domain,T.exons)], fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_xlabel("% of deletions involving the domain"); axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_title("Which dystrophin modules do pathogenic\nClinVar deletions remove?")
for i,(a,b_) in enumerate(zip(T.inframe_pct,T.oof_pct)):
    axes[0].text(a+1,i-w/2,f"{a:.0f}%",va="center",fontsize=7); axes[0].text(b_+1,i+w/2,f"{b_:.0f}%",va="center",fontsize=7)

# exon-level coverage profile
cov_i=np.zeros(80); cov_o=np.zeros(80)
for _,r in dele.iterrows():
    arr = cov_i if r.frame=="in-frame" else cov_o
    for e in range(int(r.first_exon), int(r.last_exon)+1): arr[e]+=1
axes[1].fill_between(range(1,80), cov_i[1:80], color="#55A868", alpha=.65, label="in-frame")
axes[1].fill_between(range(1,80), -cov_o[1:80], color="#C44E52", alpha=.65, label="out-of-frame")
for name,a,b in DOMAINS:
    axes[1].axvspan(a-0.5,b+0.5, alpha=.07, color="k")
    axes[1].text((a+b)/2, axes[1].get_ylim()[1]*0.0, "", ha="center")
axes[1].axhline(0,color="k",lw=.8)
axes[1].set_xlabel("DMD exon number"); axes[1].set_ylabel("deletions covering exon (n)")
axes[1].set_title("Exon coverage of pathogenic deletions by frame effect\nshaded bands = dystrophin domains")
axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
axes[1].annotate("ABD1\n2-8", xy=(5,  axes[1].get_ylim()[1]*0.8), ha="center", fontsize=7)
axes[1].annotate("R16/17\n42-45", xy=(43, axes[1].get_ylim()[1]*0.8), ha="center", fontsize=7)
axes[1].annotate("Cys-rich\n63-70", xy=(66, axes[1].get_ylim()[1]*0.8), ha="center", fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
